source_line: HubSpot portal 4451852 · CRM contacts + Marketing Email Analytics API
intro_html: Built directly from HubSpot's CRM API and marketing-email analytics, contact-level lifecycle stages, workflow enrollment lists, and per-email send data, as an independent read alongside Tim's own workflow-reporting build. Enrollment, lifecycle movement, audience and email performance were all pulled on Oct 27, 2026. Movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date. The program went live Aug 18 per the Asana launch milestone, and most contacts enrolled in bulk runs from Aug 31.

lifecycle.note_html: Contacts enrolled in a Fall 2026 nurture workflow whose lifecyclestage advanced (entered MQL, SQL, Opportunity or Customer) after the day they enrolled. Enrollment comes from each workflow's history (an ever-enrolled list per workflow), not from the nurture_track tag, which is written only when a contact completes the full workflow. Stage entries on the enrollment day itself cannot be ordered against the enrollment and are not counted.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts moved to a new lifecycle stage after they enrolled
tiles.cap: 40 in Inquiry Journeys and 13 in Inkwell, out of 6,516 enrollments across the four workflows with contacts. Great First Eight and Agnostic have none yet. 47 are MQL entries; the other 6 entered SQL, Opportunity or Customer only. 6 reached Customer (2 in Inquiry Journeys, 4 in Inkwell, all at the same school).

tiles.label: Contacts enrolled across the four workflows
tiles.cap: 5,907 in progress and 609 no longer active (removed by a suppression list or completed). Inquiry Journeys 3,379, Inkwell 2,033, Agnostic 935, Great First Eight 169. World History has none. The large majority of Inquiry Journeys enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31.

tiles.label: Of Inquiry Journeys contacts moved after enrolling, against 0.6% in Inkwell
tiles.cap: 40 of 3,379 in Inquiry Journeys and 13 of 2,033 in Inkwell. Most of the Aug 31 bulk run has now had eight weeks. Most October enrollees have had under a month, so these rates will keep rising.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts had already entered a lifecycle stage before they enrolled
tiles.cap: 140 in Inquiry Journeys and 250 in Inkwell entered MQL or a later stage between Aug 6 and their enrollment, plus 8 in Great First Eight and 1 in Agnostic. Another 55 did so on the enrollment day itself. For these contacts the content conversion that made them MQL is likely also what enrolled them, so reaching MQL cannot be counted as a nurture result. MQL to SQL is a cleaner test of the nurture.

by_program.moved_note: 40 after the enrollment day: 37 entered MQL, plus 3 whose only new stage was SQL, Opportunity or Customer. 2 reached Customer. 5 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.

13 after the enrollment day: 10 entered MQL and 3 entered Customer only. 4 total reached Customer, all contacts at the same school who became customers on Aug 31, likely a sales close. 29 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.
No stage entries after the enrollment day. 8 contacts entered a stage before they enrolled, and 1 did so on the enrollment day itself.
No stage entries after the enrollment day. 1 contact entered a stage before they enrolled. 1 enrolled contact has no enrollment date yet.
No contacts enrolled and no emails sent. Cause unconfirmed: the enrollment audience may be empty or the workflow may be off.

coverage.title: What is and is not counted
coverage.html: Enrollment counts come from lists that read each workflow's status, so every program is covered, including Great First Eight and Agnostic, which the nurture_track tag never captured. Two limits. 35 contacts (Inquiry Journeys 5, Inkwell 29, Agnostic 1) have no Nurture Enrollment Date yet, so they are counted as enrolled but cannot be counted as moved. Stage at enrollment and the converting form are not recorded yet: the three new contact properties fill in only for contacts who enroll from now on, so movement is split by date, not by the stage a contact started at.

portfolio.note_html: Ten weeks after the Aug 18 launch, delivery has grown again since the Oct 20 check (15,996 to 16,766), driven mainly by Inkwell, which added 565 delivered this week while its Leadership and Classroom modules continue to mature. Agnostic's suppression problem has worsened again: the program now suppresses 206% of what it delivers, up from 186% last week, with module 1 alone suppressing more than 3x its own delivery. That is worth checking before reading anything else into Agnostic's numbers.

tiles.label: Total delivered across the portfolio, up from 15,996 on Oct 20
tiles.cap: IJ 10,871 · Inkwell 4,746 · GF8 482 · Agnostic 667 · World History 0. Inquiry Journeys alone is 65% of all delivery.

tiles.label: Unique open rate portfolio-wide, bots excluded
tiles.cap: 4,580 unique opens on 16,766 delivered. By program: Inkwell 27.8%, Inquiry Journeys 27.7%, GF8 22.4%, Agnostic 21.7%. Click rate is 1.7% and unsubscribe 0.3%, inside the under-1% guardrail.

tiles.label: Nurture emails that have sent at all
tiles.cap: 17 of the 49 registered emails have no real volume yet: all 4 World History emails, modules 6 through 8 across Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell (both tracks, including a duplicate module 7 record in Inquiry Journeys), and Great First Eight's module 6. The ones showing 1 or 2 sends are test sends, not audience delivery.

tiles.label: Agnostic suppression rate against delivered, the worst in the portfolio
tiles.cap: 1,373 suppressed against 667 delivered program wide. Module 1 alone suppresses more than 3x what it delivers, 691 suppressed against 222 delivered. Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause is not confirmable through the API.

workflows_note_html: Confirmed by Kelsey as the only workflows currently nurturing contacts this fall; everything else in the portal's nurture history is retired. HubSpot's Automation/Workflow objects aren't exposed through the connected API, so enabled/paused state and branch logic still need a manual check in HubSpot, the performance on each card comes from the flow's marketing emails instead.

programs.label: Inquiry Journeys
programs.note_html: Leadership has sent six modules now, five at full volume (1,147, 1,179, 1,122, 886 and 819 delivered) and module 6 crossing into the 20-delivered test threshold for the first time this week (23 delivered, still too thin to read). Classroom has reached five full-volume modules (1,340, 1,293, 1,208, 947 and 886 delivered). Open rate holds in the low twenties to low thirties across modules 1 through 5, peaking at 33.1% on Classroom module 5. This program carries 65% of portfolio delivery and has 3,379 enrolled contacts, of whom 40 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (1.2%). The large majority enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31, so that cohort is now about eight weeks old and the October enrollees much younger.

programs.label: Inkwell
programs.note_html: Still the lowest suppression rate in the portfolio by a wide margin (3.5% of delivered, against 24.5% portfolio wide) and open rate edges ahead of Inquiry Journeys this week (27.8% against 27.7%). Leadership module 5, now at full volume (184 delivered), has become the strongest single open-rate result in the portfolio at 37.0% (68 of 184), narrowly ahead of Leadership module 1's 36.3% (333 of 918). Program-wide unsubscribe sits at 0.44% (21 of 4,746), under the 1% guardrail. Of 2,033 enrolled contacts, 13 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (0.6%); 4 of those are contacts at the same school who became customers on Aug 31, likely a sales close.

programs.label: Great First Eight
programs.note_html: Modules 1 through 5 now all have real volume (134, 123, 93, 69 and 61 delivered); module 6 shows 2 sends, which is a test. Clicks remain thin across the program (4 total), so no reliable click read is possible yet. Unsubscribe reads 0.62% (3 of 482), under the 1% guardrail but still thin enough that one or two people move the number. 169 contacts are enrolled and none has moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling.

programs.label: Agnostic
programs.note_html: Suppression is now dominant across the whole program: 1,373 suppressed against 667 delivered program wide, suppressing 206% of what it delivers, up from 186% last week. Module 1 alone suppresses 691 against just 222 delivered, more than 3x its own delivery. Open rate is 21.7% program wide; module 6, now at 27 delivered, is the strongest performer at 33.3% (9 of 27), though its volume is still thin. Every registered Agnostic email has sent at real volume for a second week. Worth checking the suppression lists and frequency caps on this track immediately; the cause is not confirmable from the API.

programs.label: World History
programs.note_html: Unchanged across every check since Aug 31. All four World History emails exist and carry the correct nurture property, but none has ever sent. Two possible causes, neither confirmable through the API: the enrollment audience is empty, or the workflow is not switched on. No contacts are enrolled (its ever-enrolled list is empty), so it shows no movement. The nurture_track__world_history property does not exist, but the enrollment and exit lists read workflow status and do not need it.

emails.note_html: Click-to-open rate (clicks ÷ opens, excluding bots) directly from HubSpot's marketing-email analytics, a purer read on content quality than open rate, since it isolates people who opened and then found something worth clicking. Listed: emails with real volume (20+ delivered as of the last pull); everything thinner is too early to rank. CT = Classroom Track (teacher-facing), LT = Leadership Track (admin-facing).
emails.callout_html: Inkwell's Classroom Track emails continue to convert opens to clicks better than its Leadership Track (7.9% average CTOR across five CT emails vs. 3.7% across five LT emails, about 2.1x). Inquiry Journeys shows a smaller gap (6.4% CT vs. 4.9% LT, excluding modules 6 and 7's still-thin volume), about 1.3x.

top_content.note_html: Best email per metric, per program. Bars are scaled per metric type (opened, clicked, exit each on their own scale) so they compare fairly against each other, not against raw percent. Only emails with at least 20 delivered are eligible, which excludes the 1 and 2 send test records that would otherwise show impossible rates like 100% open on a single send. Click "Details" on any tile for the preview text.

cards.empty_text: No World History email has ever sent, so there is no content to rank. See the program card above.

audience.role_note_html: Split by the contact's Role property for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow. "Admin/Leadership" groups School Leader, District Leader, and Coach/Specialist; "Other/Unassigned" is everyone without a classified role. Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell are mostly administrators and coaches, Great First Eight is mostly teachers, and Agnostic is almost entirely unclassified.
audience.source_note_html: Original source (first-touch attribution) for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow.

movement.html: Contacts enrolled in more than one workflow, counted from the four workflow history exports on Oct 13 (Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell share 92 of them). Cross-product re-routing is expected, so these contacts appear in more than one program above. This count is carried forward until a fresh set of history exports is supplied.

open_items.html: Inquiry Journeys carries 65% of delivery and 40 of its 3,379 enrolled contacts (1.2%) moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling. Inkwell moved 13 of 2,033 (0.6%), 4 of those at the same school, likely a sales close rather than a nurture result. This is not an email-performance problem: open and click rates are healthy. The open question is whether the content is moving contacts who were not already MQL.

Agnostic now suppresses more than twice what it delivers, and the gap is widening. Program wide, 1,373 suppressed against 667 delivered (206%, against 24.5% portfolio-wide), up from 186% last week. Module 1 alone suppresses more than 3x what it sends (691 suppressed, 222 delivered). Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause cannot be confirmed through the API.

Inkwell drove most of this week's delivery growth, and its Leadership module 5 is now the portfolio's top open-rate email. Inkwell added 565 delivered this week (4,181 to 4,746); Leadership module 5 reached full volume (184 delivered) at a 37.0% open rate, the strongest single result in the portfolio. Inquiry Journeys Leadership module 6 crossed the 20-delivered test threshold (23 delivered) but is still too thin to read. Modules 6 through 8 in Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell, and Great First Eight's module 6, remain mostly unsent. Ten weeks post launch on a spaced cadence, more volume is still coming in, but most of the portfolio's history is still early modules.

World History has still never sent an email, unchanged since Aug 31: 0 delivered across all 4 emails and 0 contacts enrolled. Either the enrollment audience is empty or the workflow is not live, and neither is readable via API. The missing nurture_track__world_history property no longer blocks tracking, because the lists read workflow status.

The new enrollment fields are not live for everyone yet. 35 contacts (Inquiry Journeys 5, Inkwell 29, Agnostic 1) have no enrollment date, and Nurture Stage at Enrollment and Nurture Enrollment Form are empty for every contact until the workflow steps run. Until then movement is split by date, not by the stage a contact started at, and a fresh set of workflow history exports will fill these in.

Tim's reporting-structure rebuild is still open and is now the binding constraint. It was due Aug 17 and is ten weeks overdue in Asana as of Oct 27. This page is a workaround built from raw API pulls; the Tier 1/2/3 reporting it is standing in for is what the Dec 18 program end and Jan 11 postmortem are supposed to read from.
Confirm enabled/paused state and branch logic for all 5 flows directly in HubSpot. Still not readable via API.

Query note for the next refresh: the role property stores internal values (teacher, school leader, district leader) that differ from its display labels, and the nurture_track* tag is written only when a workflow completes, so it is not used for counting. Count enrollment from the ever-enrolled and active lists listed in the workflow registry.

footnote_html: Source: HubSpot portal 4451852. CRM contact query API (lifecyclestage v2 stage-entry dates and the Nurture Enrollment Date property, read through each workflow's ever-enrolled and active lists, pulled Oct 27, 2026) and Marketing Email Analytics API (OVERVIEW, per-email, bots excluded, pulled Oct 27, 2026), scoped to the 5 confirmed Fall 2026 nurture programs via the nurture property on MARKETING_EMAIL. Lifecycle movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date (the stage entry must fall after the enrollment day). Email window Jul 30 to Oct 27, 2026. Enrolled counts include contacts who have since been removed or completed. Workflow enabled/paused state is not available via API.
